{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace_check
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace_check/raw_listing.txt
# extract basenames exactly "workspace"
:> temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ "$(basename -- "$p")" = "workspace" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt
done < temp_workspace_check/raw_listing.txt
# record types
:> temp_workspace_check/candidates_with_type.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -h "$p" ]; then t='symlink'
  elif [ -d "$p" ]; then t='directory'
  elif [ -f "$p" ]; then t='regular_file'
  elif [ -b "$p" ]; then t='block_device'
  elif [ -c "$p" ]; then t='char_device'
  elif [ -p "$p" ]; then t='fifo'
  elif [ -S "$p" ]; then t='socket'
  else t='nonexistent'
  fi
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$t" >> temp_workspace_check/candidates_with_type.txt
done < temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt
# verify current state against recorded
:> temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt
while IFS=$'\t' read -r p recorded; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -h "$p" ]; then cur='symlink'
  elif [ -d "$p" ]; then cur='directory'
  elif [ -f "$p" ]; then cur='regular_file'
  elif [ -b "$p" ]; then cur='block_device'
  elif [ -c "$p" ]; then cur='char_device'
  elif [ -p "$p" ]; then cur='fifo'
  elif [ -S "$p" ]; then cur='socket'
  else cur='nonexistent'
  fi
  if [ "$cur" = "$recorded" ] && [ "$cur" != 'nonexistent' ]; then
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$cur" >> temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_check/candidates_with_type.txt
# concise summary
count=$(wc -l < temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
{
  printf 'verified_count: %s\n' "$count"
  cat temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt 2>/dev/null
} > temp_workspace_check/summary.txt
# final answer: is there any regular file named workspace under /working?
if grep -q $'\t''regular_file' temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt 2>/dev/null; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
